name: 10-host-welcome
prompt: A host in a dark suit greeting an arriving senior guest with a handshake at the door of a dark private dining room, warm light spilling out, guest's face in soft focus, elegant and discreet. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
